{{Quote|This is the Tyranny. Responding to Code Zero. Be aware that you have altered plans set by Lord Vader himself, and you will answer to him if this code as been invoked lightly.|Unidentified Tyranny Commander responding to Emergency Code Zero|<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>}}
This '''commander''' was in command of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tyranny]]'' during the [[Space Battle at Kuat|Space Battle at]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the battle, he refused to reinforce the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]], citing orders to stay at [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]]. After the facility was destroyed, he arrived at Kuat in response to [[Emergency Code Zero (Imperial)|Emergency Code Zero]], but warned the [[Unidentified Kuat communications officer|Comm Officer]] that if this Code was invoked lightly, he will answer to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]].
